title: Crash retrieval program head refused to talk

tellings.quote: Well, I would love to talk to the head of the crash retrieval program during that era, but he refused to talk to us. And that was that was Glen Gaffne.

plain: The man who headed a secret programme to recover crashed craft during that era, named as Glenn Gaffney, refused to be interviewed, according to the physicist Eric W. Davis. Davis says this in connection with the film project Age of Disclosure: "I would love to talk to the head of the crash retrieval program during that era, but he refused to talk to us." Had Gaffney talked, he could have spoken to whether such a programme exists.
